sql: SELECT d.n, f.field, d.text, p.key, p.value FROM doc_lines d LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'min_age' AS field, 'age' AS pkey, 'aged{0,1} [0-9]+ or older|at least [0-9]+ years|[0-9]+ years (of age ){0,1}or older|[0-9]+ years old' AS pat UNION ALL SELECT 'mode', 'can_attend_onsite', 'in-person|in person|onsite|on-site|online|remote' UNION ALL SELECT 'fee', 'budget_usd', 'fee|free|cost|[$][0-9]' UNION ALL SELECT 'deliverables', 'can_produce', 'video|deck|slides|github|repository|source code|proposal|application form|essay' UNION ALL SELECT 'deadline', CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'deadline|clos|due|submit') f ON regexp_like(LOWER(d.text), f.pat) LEFT JOIN profile p ON p.key = f.pkey WHERE d.doc=? ORDER BY d.n, f.field
